# lib/pid module

Vendor-agnostic fixed-point PID controller. This page is the reference for the `lib/pid` HAL module, for firmware authors choosing and wiring it in.

| Fact | Value |
|---|---|
| Module id | `lib/pid` |
| Source | [`lib/pid`](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/tree/master/lib/pid) |
| Families | PIC16F87XA, PIC16F88X, PIC18Fxx5x |
| Parts, PIC16F87XA | 16F873A, 16LF873A, 16F873, 16F874, 16F874A, 16F876, 16F876A, 16F877, 16F877A |
| Parts, PIC16F88X | 16F883, 16F884, 16F886, 16F887 |

| Simulator limits | None documented |

## Use it

The manifest lists one example program per family. Build it with the repository build driver, or read it as the working starting point for your own firmware.

| Family | Example | Source |
|---|---|---|
| PIC16F87XA | `pid` | [`lib/pid/examples/example_pid.c`](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/blob/master/lib/pid/examples/example_pid.c) |
| PIC16F88X | `pid` | [`lib/pid/examples/example_pid.c`](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/blob/master/lib/pid/examples/example_pid.c) |
| PIC18Fxx5x | `pid` | [`lib/pid/examples/example_pid.c`](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/blob/master/lib/pid/examples/example_pid.c) |

## API

The API is documented next to the code, in the [`lib/pid` directory](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/tree/master/lib/pid). This page does not restate it. This is a documentation gap: the manifest carries no function list to generate a table from.

## Limits

- Not built for 16F870, 16F871, 16F872. Reason: RAM: sizecheck _g_pid does not fit (XC8 error 1250).
